scope: Phase 2 development-only surgical NoPnx1 quality adjudication

edit_level_supported_precision.definition: SUPPORTED_CORRECTION + SUPPORTED_ALTERNATIVE / all adjudicated applied NoPnx1 edits
edit_level_supported_precision.confidence_interval: NOT_CALCULATED: edits clustered by passage; no naive 60-independent interval

quality_control.pass_1: all 41 passage clusters, 60 applied edits, 150 targets, 100 suppressed hazards
quality_control.pass_2: same-agent recheck of all wrong, supported alternatives, useful-loss candidates, high/critical and review-required decisions

limitations: An AUTO_ACCEPT_CANDIDATE passage may retain errors at untouched target locations; it means its applied edits are supported under the development rule.
Suppressed predictions lack a safe mapped replacement and confidence in the queue; no confirmed useful correction can be inferred merely from resemblance of a label.
The 150 target rows are clustered in 41 passages; the one-location Nahw references do not fully correct each passage.
No threshold tuning, new inference, sealed benchmark or production acceptance performed.
